voiceScript: If your phone suddenly loses service, your number may be under attack. SIM Swapping means a criminal convinces a mobile carrier to move your number to a SIM card or device they control. Picture this: your phone suddenly loses service while password-reset codes reach somebody else. Here is why that matters: the criminal may reset email, banking, or social accounts. Call your carrier from another phone if service disappears unexpectedly. Add a carrier PIN and prefer an authenticator app over text codes.
